x: Green was placed second in the International 100 Kilometres Race at Milan, finishing five minutes behind Brignoli, the Italian, whose time was 10hrs. 25mins. D. Pavesi, (Italy) was third in 10hrs. 59mins.

The race, as a whole, did not attract a strong complement of our best walkers, and to-day, Donato Pavesi, watching Green on his way to certain victory, regretted that he could not go back over the years to the age of his efficiency.
